biography.plain_text: William L. Deary III is an American healthcare entrepreneur and investor who co-founded Great Lakes Caring with his wife, Cherilyn, in Jackson, Michigan. As chairman and chief executive, he helped expand a local home-health and hospice provider into a multi-state company serving thousands of patients before leaving the business in 2017.
biography.html: William L. Deary III is an American healthcare entrepreneur and investor who co-founded Great Lakes Caring with his wife, Cherilyn, in Jackson, Michigan. As chairman and chief executive, he helped expand a local home-health and hospice provider into a multi-state company serving thousands of patients before leaving the business in 2017.

confidence.reason: Official university and government records establish the exact name, nationality, joint founding and Jackson base. Industry reporting establishes his chairman and chief-executive role, multi-state scale and departure in 2017, while recent institutional reporting supports the investor description.

long_biography.plain_text:
The company began in 1994 after Cherilyn, a registered nurse, returned to Jackson to help an ill relative and saw that the area lacked home-care options. Deary translated that clinical need into an operating model built around patient service and employee retention. Growth came organically and through acquisitions, ultimately producing 26 offices, more than 3,200 employees and annual revenue above $225 million.

Private-equity firms invested in the business over successive ownership changes, and Deary remained chief executive with a significant stake in the 2016 transaction. After leaving the company, he broadened his portfolio through a partner syndicate that owned several hotels and a residential development. He also invested in healthcare-data and laboratory businesses and supported nursing education and university athletics through major gifts.
